वैमानिक

VAIMĀNIKA . A holy place. Mention is made in mahābhārata, anuśāsana parva, Chapter 25, Stanza 23, that those who bathe in this holy place could freely walk about in the world of the celestial maids.

वैमित्रा

VAIMITRĀ . One of the saptamātṛs (seven mothers). They are vaimitrā, kākī, halimā, mālinī, Bṛhadā, āryā and palālā. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 228, Stanza 10).
